capabilities: Branch AI chat replies into child nodes by selecting text and pressing Tab
Chat with any OpenAI-compatible API endpoint
Navigate maps as an interactive graph with keyboard shortcuts
Attach and edit personal notes on nodes
Export maps to Obsidian Canvas, Markdown, and Mermaid mindmaps
disambiguation: Not a web crawler or scraper; it renders branching AI chat sessions as a navigable node map.
extras: Maps are stored locally as .spider/maps/*.json and sync via Obsidian Sync; no client-side usage analytics; bilingual Chinese/English UI; README includes a roadmap of unfinished features.
problem: AI chats are linear, so drilling into a term means copy-pasting into a new window and losing the original thread, with no way to turn the exploration into linked notes.

relations.evidence: any OpenAI-compatible API into a branching knowledge map
Local LLMs: Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio — all expose OpenAI-compatible endpoints

requires.name: Local LLM server (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio)

summary: Branching AI chat plugin that turns OpenAI-compatible conversations into an interactive knowledge map with Tab-to-branch navigation and structured exports.
